title: RETAKE
statusNote: Built 2026-11-03 from the VERIFY lineage: a liveness app, one ordinary person, a smile ladder that passes on a frown, and a robot verified instantly. Four Veo Quality takes (one retake for the direction of the second turn), interface, sounds and composites local. The director approved v2 (20.75 s) and authorized the 4K finish, which redraws the interface natively at 2160x3840, scales the feed locally and carries the approved AAC stream unchanged. Published as a YouTube Short on 2026-11-03 (URL user-confirmed) with the director's edited description. Technical checks, artistic approval and publication are recorded as separate events; real-time listening is not claimed. Archived 2026-11-03 under the standard retention: the 4K master, every take and still, the composites at both resolutions, the audio stems, manifests, decisions, recipes, ledgers and QA are retained; the v1 and v2 native edits, their debug copies, assembly segments and the derived mixes were removed (19 files) after the master was re-verified.

credits.role: Concept, direction, shot planning, image and motion generation, interface, editing, sound and finishing

reviewEvents.evidence: Assembler verified full decode, 1080x1920, 528 frames at 24/1 fps and the source hashes. Listening and artistic review are not claimed.
